camel_example: aliyun aideepsign CreateWatermarkEmbedTask --region cn-hangzhou --FileType video --Level 2 --version 2026-05-11 --method POST --force
description_en: Submits an image or video file for invisible watermark embedding and returns a task ID for querying the result
description_zh: 提交图片或视频文件进行暗水印嵌入，返回任务ID用于查询结果
name: CreateWatermarkEmbedTask

parameters.help_en: A reserved idempotency field. This field is not supported. Passing a value does not cause an error, but it does not produce an idempotency effect
parameters.help_zh: 预留幂等字段，暂不支持。传入不会报错，但当前不产生幂等效果
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The file type. Valid values:
image: image.
video: video.

The value must match the actual file type
parameters.help_zh: 文件类型，取值：image（图片）、video（视频），须与实际文件类型一致
parameters.name: file_type

parameters.help_en: The URL of the file to be processed. Images and videos are supported. Only the HTTP and HTTPS protocols are supported. Videos must be no longer than 10 minutes and no larger than 100 MB
parameters.help_zh: 待处理文件的 URL 地址，支持图片和视频，仅支持 http/https 协议；视频仅支持 10 分钟以内、100MB 以内
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.help_en: The watermark content. The embedded content can be restored to the original text by calling the extraction operation
parameters.help_zh: 水印内容。嵌入产物可由提取接口还原该文本
parameters.name: watermark_content

parameters.help_en: The embedding strength. Valid values: 0 to 5. A higher strength provides better robustness but lower visual quality
parameters.help_zh: 嵌入强度，取值 0-5。强度越高鲁棒性越好、视觉质量越差
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en: A reserved field. No valid values are available. Do not specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 预留字段，当前无有效取值，建议调用时不传
parameters.name: reserved

Code.description_en: The business error code. The value OK is returned if the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码。请求成功时返回 "OK"

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. The value 200 is returned if the request is successful
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 200

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

TaskId.description_en: The invisible watermark embedding task ID. Use this ID to call GetWatermarkEmbedTaskResult to query the result
TaskId.description_zh: 暗水印嵌入任务 ID，用于调用 `GetWatermarkEmbedTaskResult` 查询结果
TaskId.title_en: 暗水印嵌入任务ID，用于后续GetWatermarkEmbedTaskResult查询
TaskId.title_zh: 暗水印嵌入任务ID，用于后续GetWatermarkEmbedTaskResult查询
